newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe dollar ends firmer on major currencies.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe dollar ends firmer on major currencies.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Thursday slightly firmer against most major currencies, including the U.S. dollar, but foreign exchange dealers said it was likely to trade in narrow ranges in coming days ahead of the Christmas and New Year holidays.
"Things are getting quiet. A lot of companies are now closing for the holidays and many of them have already met their commitments," one dealer said.
"Real business will start again from mid-next month," he added.
The Zimbabwe dollar was indicated at 10.7400/7600 on the U.S. unit, up from 10.7425/7625 at Wednesday's close.
It was quoted stronger at 6.9400/9600 on the mark from 6.9643/9809 and on the South African rand at 2.2600/2800 compared to 2.2944/3012.
The local unit also closed firmer at 17.7200/7700 on sterling from 17.7767/8205.
